windows.notes:
Security fixes. Updating is recommended.
- Alert email addresses and push links of backup jobs run by the system (as SYSTEM or root) are kept where only administrators can read them, no longer in the job files every user can read.
- Phone: ucopy's own files (pairing keys, share logins, signing keys, copies of messages and contacts) no longer leave the phone through Android's backup or a transfer to a new phone. On a new phone, set ucopy up again; your backups still open with their password.
- Phone: other apps can no longer make ucopy ask about backing up to a drive, or act as if a drive was plugged in.

macos.notes:
Fixes for disk images.
- An image of a disk that was interrupted now carries on where it stopped, instead of reading the whole disk again (which wears a failing disk). It first checks a few sectors, so another disk at the same place, or an image damaged since, is imaged again.
- An image that can't be opened is never carried on in a new, empty file.
- Image a disk: the snapshot option now says that free space isn't read.
